product_metadata.title: Household Essentials Polyester Mesh Wash Bags, 2 Lingerie and 1 Sweater, Set of 3
features: This set of 3 laundry mesh wash bags provides soft mesh bags to protect delicate articles of clothing and accessories from excess wear and tear during storage or washing.
Provides 1 large and 2 medium-sized wash bags made of durable yet soft polyester fabric that protects delicates from snags and allows for thorough washing.
Use these laundry wash bags to protect your bras, lace underwear and more during the wash.
The durable plastic zippers keep smaller accessories contained through washing, drying and storage.
Large: 28” H x 20” W; medium: 18” H x 10” W
description: This set of 3 laundry mesh wash bags is the perfect option for those looking for a way to machine wash delicate clothing, without the fear of wear and tear. This set comes with 1 large and 2 medium wash bags to accommodate larger or smaller articles of clothing. These wash bags are also great for detailed drawer organization or suitcase storage. These soft laundry wash bags offer your delicate articles of clothing a gentle washing free of snags, twisting and other wear. Unlike other wash bags, these are made of durable, white polyester mesh to provide excellent protection and encourage thorough washing. The adorable pink zippers make these bags an attractive addition to your drawer organization and easy to spot amongst other fabrics in the wash. This set offers 2 sizes of wash bags to meet your ever-changing needs. The larger wash bag is perfect for lace blouses and sweaters, while the medium bags can be used for ties, bras, underwear and other lingerie. These bags are great for keeping smaller accessories such as handkerchiefs, gloves and socks from getting lost in the wash. While these laundry wash bags are mainly for machine washing, they can also be used for handwashing and organizing accessory drawers. You could even use these bags in suitcases to store dirty laundry, organize toiletries or keep tabs on easily-lost undergarments as you travel. These laundry wash bags would be perfect for anyone looking to spare themselves the time and effort of handwashing but still wants to keep their delicate clothing looking fantastic. With the use of this laundry mesh wash bags, your delicate pieces of clothing will remain safe and snag-free, even in more harsh washing cycles..
